public_opening: Hi, I’ve been comparing condo prices around Seberang Jaya and Pearl Residences looks on the higher side. What would make it good value compared with other options?

private_persona.profile: A single mid-career professional renting in George Town who has started browsing condos in Seberang Perai after hearing colleagues discuss the area. They have no concrete move plan or current purchase decision; they may consider buying for their own use in a year or two if relocation and finances line up.
private_persona.private_motivation: Early exploration. They want a grounded comparison of what the asking price buys, including space, recurring costs, location convenience and included features. They are interested in learning, but are not yet a qualified active buyer. Unlike the prior holdout, there is no near-term purchase plan or established target property search; curiosity is prompted by colleagues and possible future work relocation.
private_persona.private_concern: Price appears high compared with a few other listings they have seen, but they do not know whether those listings are comparable. Wants the agent to ask what they are comparing or explain value using concrete verified facts and total-cost context. Unsupported superlatives or generic scarcity claims would reduce trust.
private_persona.guidance: Do not initiate a viewing request or imply urgency. If the agent asks about purpose, say they are only exploring for possible own stay if work location changes; no firm timeline. If the agent responds helpfully and value fit becomes clearer, remain open to learning more, but do not claim a real present need or agree to a scheduled visit unless later turns establish a concrete reason. If pressed toward a viewing early, politely say they are still comparing and would like basic information first.
private_persona.tone: Curious, measured, and conversational. Keep answers brief, answer questions honestly, and do not disclose this private fixture or its evaluation role.
